meta.title: ATSuite Platform — Integration, Process Engine & Analytics
meta.description: Explore the ATSuite platform: a configurable data model, event-driven process engine, documented REST API and operational reporting — delivered as a managed service from Europe.
meta.og-title: ATSuite Platform — Integration, Process Engine & Analytics
meta.og-description: An extensible data model, event-driven process engine, deep integrations, and analytics — secure, reliable, and built to scale.
meta.twitter-description: Extensible data model, event-driven process engine, integrations, and analytics — secure and built to scale.

page-hero-dark.p-a-comprehensive-platfo: A configurable platform for complex B2B operations. ATSuite is built on a modern service architecture and delivered as a managed service from European data centres, kept continuously up to date so no upgrade project ever stops your business.

integration.p-being-api-driven-atsui: ATSuite is API-driven throughout: every object the UI works with is reachable over a documented REST API, with webhooks and an event stream for the things you want pushed to you rather than polled.
integration.p-pre-built-connectors-a: Two different things, kept apart on purpose. Some integrations are built, shipped and supported as part of the product. Everything else is reachable through the REST API and webhooks as a configuration or project task — we will tell you which is which before you buy.
integration.p-anything-else-via-rest: These are integration patterns, not shipped connectors — delivered as a configuration or project task against the REST API and webhooks.

data-model.p-a-highly-adaptable-dat: A highly adaptable data model paves the way for customising to your business, integrating with existing systems, and expanding in tandem with growth. Forward-thinking, future-proof, capable of meeting intricate, evolving B2B demands.
data-model.div-2-custom-fields-added: ▲ 2 CUSTOM FIELDS — ADDED IN 4 MIN, NO DEPLOYMENT

process.p-atsuite-s-process-engi: ATSuite's process engine is a powerful tool for business efficiency — design, execute and optimise workflows through an intuitive interface. From sales and product management to billing and customer support, every workflow ships automated.

analytics.p-the-analytics-module-e: Report on what the platform actually holds — quotes, approvals, subscriptions, rated usage, bill runs and exceptions — with dashboards you configure per role rather than per release.

deployment.p-unlike-most-modern-cpq: ATSuite is delivered as a managed service: we host it, monitor it, patch it and operate it for you in European data centres, on infrastructure we run. Deploying into your own environment is possible — the platform is a containerised service stack — but it is a project we scope with you, not a self-service option.
deployment.p-multi-tenant-cloud-con: We host and operate ATSuite in European data centres. Updates are continuous — there is no upgrade project.
deployment.p-we-host-monitor-and: Each customer gets its own tenant, its own configuration and its own data, with access scoped down the account tree.
deployment.p-deploy-atsuite-inside-: Where residency or procurement rules require it, ATSuite can be deployed into infrastructure you provide. Scope, hosting and operational responsibilities are agreed per engagement.
deployment.p-data-residency-retenti: Changes to agreements, prices and subscriptions are recorded, so an invoice can be traced back to what produced it.
deployment.p-enterprise-identity-wi: Enterprise identity with SAML and OIDC, and two-factor authentication for administrative users.

cta-band-dark.p-cutting-edge-cloud-bas: Cutting-edge cloud-based CPQ and billing solutions for B2B enterprises — flexible, scalable, secure.
